units.source_text: 正如千重子在清水寺对真一说过的，

en.t: Just as Chieko had told Shin'ichi at Kiyomizu Temple,

units.source_text: 千重子不是阿繁夫妇从赏夜樱的圆山公园里抢来的，

en.t: Chieko had not been snatched away by Shige and his wife from Maruyama Park while they were viewing the night cherry blossoms,

units.source_text: 而是被人扔在店铺门口，太吉郎把她抱回来的。

en.t: but had been abandoned by someone at the shop entrance, and Takichiro had brought her inside in his arms.
